title: 2013 Score #365 Eric Reid San Francisco 49ers Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This sports trading card features Eric Reid, a rookie player for the San Francisco 49ers. The card is part of the 2013 Score set manufactured by Panini. It has a card number of 365 and is categorized as a trading card single. The card is perfect for collectors who are interested in football and want to add a piece from their favorite team to their collection. The card is not autographed and has a few features that make it stand out from other trading cards.
